system.description:
Adjust Appearance: You shift your
appearance and clothing with light- z
bending fabric, facial projection, —
skinmesh, or disguise tech to avoid
recognition.
Target Splitter: Spend 2 Hope to
activate this targeting assist on
yourself or an ally within Close range.
. The next time the target makes an
attack, they can hit an additional target
within range that their attack roll would
succeed against. You can only hold this
protocol on one creature at atime.
Hard-Light Decoy: Make an Interface
Roll (14). On a success, create a
temporary visual projection, hard-light
duplicate, false object, or tactical
hologram no larger than you within
Close range that lasts for as long as
you look at it. It holds up to scrutiny
until an observer is within Melee range.
